assets.title: Biometric fingerprints colored
assets.reuseBasis: The source image page credits N. Hanacek/NIST and does not mark the image as copyrighted. NIST's general policy permits copying or distribution of information not marked as copyrighted and requests appropriate image credit.
assets.modifications: None; original downloaded bytes retained. Displayed at a smaller responsive size with an adjacent caption and source link.
assets.teachingUse: Supplementary fingerprint-ridge example in 6.1.3 Biometrics. The image does not replace the enrolment, capture, feature-comparison or authentication explanations. Colours are described as illustrative, not matching scores.
assets.visualReview: Inspected the original 1800 by 1200 image. It contains six coloured fingerprint impressions. Source and credit are visible in the teaching caption.
